# `csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_code`

Maximum consecutive blank lines between statements.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `1`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        int a = 1;



        int b = 2;



        Console.WriteLine(a + b);
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        int a = 1;



        int b = 2;



        Console.WriteLine(a + b);
    }
}
```
:::

::::

*Curb recognises this key but does not yet reformat this construct — Before and After are identical.*
